title: Equivalence Partitioning — Overview
summary: Dividing inputs into classes expected to behave the same, then testing one value per class.
body:
Dividing inputs into classes expected to behave the same, then testing one value per class. Classic black-box technique.

Approaches commonly used alongside it include BVA, Decision Tables, Black-Box Testing.
